profile.headline: Software Engineer at Google
profile.summary:
I'm a design-driven Machine Learning Engineer able to leverage my Software Engineering background to design and implement machine learning architectures.  I am well-versed in all facets of the product development life cycle, from feature cleaning, visualization and analysis through model development, implementation, validation, and documentation.

A listing of my core competencies includes:
* deep learning
* natural language processing
* supervised, unsupervised, and reinforced learning
* neural networks, clustering, filtering, and classification techniques
* test-driven development and business-driven development techniques

TECHNICAL SKILLS:

Languages:
Python, Java, MATLAB, R, Octave, SQL, C++, C

Python Libraries:
Tensorflow, PyTorch, Keras, numpy, pandas, matplotlib, scikit-learn, scipy

Please contact me directly at alexphillipmartinez@gmail.com

Github link: https://github.com/earlofyor714
Kaggle link: https://www.kaggle.com/alexphillipmartinez

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Skills: Docker Products · Testing · Jenkins · Design Patterns · Anaconda · GraphQL · Amazon Web Services (AWS)

positions.title: Machine Learning Engineer
positions.description:
Worked on a small startup to plan, design, and implement a computer vision model, web service APIs, and supporting architecture.

-Developed using Python to handle the pre-processing of video feed on an edge device, process the data in the cloud, and generate new footage.
-Implemented Object Detection and Object Tracking techniques for Computer Vision applications.
-Technologies included Python 3, Bash, Tensorflow 2.0, Docker, Linux OS, Git, Jetson TX2/Nano, and AWS

positions.title: Software Engineer: C#, C
positions.description: Programmed using bash scripting, C# and C with Unity to program an escape room.  Set up a custom network protocol using TCP so one device could override the flow of the escape room.  Set up UDP connection between a Microsoft Kinect connected to one device so that it could control the current states of several other devices (Arduino microcontrollers and Unity games on several PCs).  Developed several mini-games in Unity framework.  Wrote the code for all of the Arduino microcontrollers used in the escape room.  End result was a fully developed escape room delivered within the contract timeline that received an average of 5 star ratings on several review sites (CTRL+ALT Reality is the name of room I worked on).

positions.title: Sessional Instructor
positions.description:
Courses I am currently teaching include the Machine Learning Engineering Nanodegree and the Business Analyst Nanodegree.

Responsible for teaching students the process from data gathering and cleaning, performing data analysis, and building machine learning models to identify patterns and make predictions.

positions.title: Software Engineer: Java, MySQL
positions.description:
Knowledge and experience managing global data.  Experience communicating with diverse teams including data scientists, software engineers, product and project managers, and executive management.  Dataset experience in document, graph, and log data.

* Implemented support for tools to monitor API throughput and load, enhancing test coverage to 90% and 5% more load capacity
* Led effort in virtualizing services through Docker and Vagrant, cutting down project ramp-up time by 2 weeks per person on average.
